visual_summary: At dawn on a bright, washed-out landscape, a large bulbous ceremonial tree stands near a distant city or complex. The narration shows Don Nicanor Rosamel de Rokha meditating there as part of a public ecological ritual. In the next panels, citizens in leaf-like or hooded attire repeat a mantra from terraces and among foliage overlooking the same distant site. The final large panel reveals a gigantic battleship descending or looming over the city, its vast illuminated underside casting a shadow across the skyline while crowds watch from rooftops and platforms.
